title: CM directs officials to fast-track Sonepur airport; ₹6,500 crore phase one
summary: At a review meeting in Patna, Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary directed officials to speed up land acquisition and every remaining procedure for the Sonepur Greenfield International Airport on a fixed timeline. The first phase is to be funded with about ₹6,500 crore under a public-private partnership, with the state covering land acquisition and connectivity under the Bihar Raiyoti Land Purchase Policy, 2026. Officials reviewed the airport's master plan and were told to design it for large aircraft, with attention to cargo facilities. The airport is expected to improve air connectivity for 22 districts of Bihar and neighbouring districts of Jharkhand and Uttar Pradesh.

title: Bihar Cabinet moves ahead new highways linking the airport site
summary: Bihar's Road Construction Department brought two greenfield highway proposals to Cabinet for in-principle approval, both to be built and tolled by Bihar State Road Development Corporation Limited under a PPP (design-build-finance-operate-transfer) model. One is a roughly 73.5 km four-lane highway connecting Darihara (Konhua) in Saran district to Dumaria Ghat in Gopalganj district. The other is a roughly 56 km 'North Ganga Path' connecting Bidupur to Dighwara. Both proposals seek approval to appoint a DPR consultant and transaction advisor, an early step before construction tendering.
source: Bihar Road Construction Department, Cabinet agenda

title: Detailed project report for Sonepur airport due within a month
summary: RITES Ltd is preparing the DPR. After the state gives in-principle approval, the Airports Authority of India is expected to invite bids under a public-private partnership. Construction is targeted to begin in 2027, with completion before 2030. The project cost is put at about ₹10,000 crore including land. The district administration has begun land acquisition, including a Social Impact Assessment.

title: Bihar clears two new greenfield airports: Sonpur and Sultanganj
summary: Reports say the state has approved greenfield airports in Sonpur (Saran) and Sultanganj (Bhagalpur), with land acquisition funding, to ease pressure on Patna airport and improve air travel for nearby districts.

title: Cabinet approves the Sonepur greenfield international airport
summary: The Bihar Cabinet approved the airport among 35 items. It will come up on about 4,200 acres in the Dariyapur Chanwar area between Hajipur and Dumaria, with two long runways and a 2030 target. ₹1,302 crore was sanctioned for land acquisition, and officials expect it to rank among India's largest airports.

title: Site sits north of NH-19, east of the Gandak river
summary: The proposed airport covers about 4,228 acres in the Dariyapur Chawar area, north of the Sonepur–Chhapra four-lane NH-19 and east of the Gandak. It is planned on the lines of the Noida and Navi Mumbai airports.

title: State budget 2026-27 names Sonepur airport land acquisition
summary: In the budget speech the finance minister said the government is working towards administrative approval of ₹1,302 crore to acquire 4,228 acres at Sonepur. It would be the state's third greenfield airport after Bhagalpur and Rajgir.
